newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Gulf Petrochemical H1 operating income up 55 pct.
newsitem.headline: Gulf Petrochemical H1 operating income up 55 pct.

text.p: Gulf Petrochemical Industries Co (GPIC) said on Wednesday it posted operating income of 18 million dinar ($47.7 million) in the first six months of 1997.
A GPIC statement gave no comparative figure but said the income was 55 percent higher from the same period in 1996.
Bahrain-based GPIC posted a $52 million operating income in the entire 1996, down 42.2 percent from $90 million in 1995.
The statement said GPIC produced 220,000 tonnes of amonia and 222,000 tonnes of methanol in the first six months of 1997.
GPIC is owned by the Bahrain National Oil Co, Saudi Arabia's industrial giant Saudi Basic Industries Corp and Kuwait's Petrochemical Industries Co.
